description: Change a project rule in SystemDox Standards by its id (get_project_rules shows each rule's id). Give new words, a new category, or both; the rule keeps its id. Use this when a rule is out of date or filed under the wrong category.

id.description: The rule's id, as get_project_rules shows it (e.g. 'rul_…')

text.description: The rule's new words — one enforceable principle, not blank

name: update_project_rule
title: Update Project Rule
